policy.process_exit_policy: Validated target-unavailable FPM rejection requires two fresh PID-directory ENOENT checks under the same proc root; live, unreadable, partial and reused identities reject
policy.timestamp_policy: explicit RFC3339 offsets normalized to UTC; no naive or unknown offsets
policy.unreadable_process_scope: UID 33 read-only FPM observation bound to PID, UID, start ticks and command hash; ambiguous evidence rejected
